title: 都市・まちづくり
subtitle: Urban Planning and Local Development
keywords: urban spaces 2.local development 3.urban and regional planning 4.history of city formation and transition 5.sustainable communities
educationalGoal: Students will: 1) acquire fundamental knowledge on city planning and local development (their concepts, important terms, and methods). 2) learn histories of city formations and transitions and their characteristics. 3) learn good examples of city planning & local development and their characteristics and significance.
advice: this course provides basic knowledge and skills for city planning and local development in collaboration with local residents, local government, and other related entities. We will cover the following materials: 1. world histories of city formations and transitions from the ancient times to the present age, and their characteristics 2. urban problems in the modern era, theories and measures to deal with them, and present trends of urbanism 3. basic framework of city planning in Japan 4. details of local development activities 5. practical examples of local development and their methods
requiredKnowledge: No special knowledge is required to take this course.
